data.one_liner: Provides a SuperellipseShape widget to draw superellipse shapes in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: The package supplies a Material-compatible SuperellipseShape widget that renders a shape transitioning between a rectangle and a circle. It accepts a BorderRadiusGeometry to control corner curvature and works on all Flutter platforms.
use_when: You need a custom superellipse (rounded‑rectangle‑to‑circle) shape in your UI
You want a simple, null‑safe widget without extra dependencies
avoid_when: You require complex animated shape morphing
You need a full UI kit or extensive theming beyond a single shape
strengths: Easy to integrate as a regular widget
Supports null‑safety and all Flutter platforms
weaknesses: No built‑in animation or advanced styling options
